Last night’s showdown was a clear victory for Iran and a clear defeat for Trump — although he’ll of course frame it as a victory.

Some thoughts on the bigger picture... robertreich.substack.com/p/h…

It’s never been more clear that Donald Trump has completely lost his mind.

It’s our responsibility to call on Congress, the military, and any sane individual in this administration to stop him from committing war crimes against the Iranian people.

Video

Trump has really, seriously, frighteningly lost his mind. 

It won’t happen soon, but if Trump continues to deteriorate, Republicans won’t have any alternative but to remove him from office. Neither will America. robertreich.substack.com/p/t…

Billionaires are crying foul about California's proposed wealth tax.

Don't fall for their fearmongering.

A one-time, 5% tax on their excessive wealth is essential to funding what millions of Californians need — and to preserving our democracy.

Video

Average wage growth for workers is now at the slowest pace in 5 years — and could soon be eaten up by inflation.

Meanwhile, CEO pay continues to skyrocket through the stratosphere.

Imagine what our economy would look like if worker pay grew like CEO pay.

Video

Throughout history, war has always been part of the authoritarian playbook. 

That’s because war allows so-called "strongmen" to feign strength, even if they are operating from a place of weakness. 

This is exactly what is happening to Donald Trump.

Video

Trump is cornered, and he’s going stark-raving mad. Some thoughts on his latest outburst...

Raising taxes on the rich in Washington.

Paid family and medical leave in Virginia.

Even in these Trump times, there's good news to be found.

"All we say to America is, 'Be true to what you said on paper.'"

These words — spoken by MLK Jr. shortly before he was killed on this day in 1968 — ring just as true now.

Let's honor his legacy by continuing the fight for social and economic justice.

Today seems like a good day to debunk the 12 biggest myths about taxing the rich.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pnoLAMHwf2I

Effective 2025 federal tax rates paid by these corporations:

Alphabet: 8.01%
AT&T: 4.6%
Meta: 3.57%
General Motors: 3.09%
Amazon: 1.37%
Exxon Mobil: 1.31%
Disney: -1.57%
CVS Health: -3.88%

Income tax rate paid by the typical American: 14.5%

This is what a rigged system looks like.

2.5 million Americans are no longer receiving food stamp benefits since the passage of Trump and Republicans’ big, ugly bill.

They used a pack of lies to justify their egregious cuts to the program. Don’t believe it for a second.  https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8StUs6Ufe_4

Residents of a small Wisconsin town just passed a first-of-its-kind referendum on AI data center development. 

Tax incentives for future data centers will now require voter approval.

Kudos to these residents for taking on Big Tech. Never doubt your power to change the system.

Trump accepted $37 million worth of donated foreign steel for his White House ballroom from a corporation based in Luxembourg.

Just days later, the Trump administration made major cuts to tariffs on steel imports that could significantly benefit that corporation.

"America First."

You know something has gone terribly wrong when 94% of teachers have to dip into their own pockets to buy school supplies while the average Wall Street employee got a bonus of $246,900 in 2025. Hello?
This is a reminder that positive change can still happen at the state level.

"Nationwide, the bottom 20% of earners effectively face state and local tax rates nearly 60% higher than those in the top 1%."

Who's profiting from ridiculous and unnecessary wars?  Big Oil CEOs, to name one obvious group. @emorwee.bsky.social  
heated.world/p/chevrons-c...

BREAKING: House Republicans blocked a resolution to end Trump's war on Iran.

The Republican presiding gaveled out the session without even calling the measure to a vote.

Under our constitution, Congress has the sole power to declare war. Refusing to even hold a vote on it is shameful & cowardly.

Reminder: Corporate consolidation, like what we've seen over the years in the airline industry, leads to less competition.

It gives the biggest remaining corporations the power to rip you off and protect profits because you have fewer options from whom to buy from.

For every $1 the IRS spends auditing the top 1%, it could collect roughly $13.

For every $1 the IRS spends auditing the top 0.1%, it could collect $26.

Wondering why the Trump regime has cut 25,000 IRS employees in the last year?

It's about making it easier for the rich to evade taxes.

Harmeet Dhillon is the last person who should be running the Civil Rights Division of the Justice Department. She should never become attorney general — which means Trump will probably nominate her. Here's what you should know.
a “ceasefire” that lasted 17 hours and killed 254 people in lebanon is not a ceasefire and referring to it as one is inaccurate
We're living through the doom loop once again.

A reminder: The Attorney General of the United States should be the people's lawyer, not the president's personal attorney. The Department of Justice should act to protect the public, not the occupant of the Oval Office and his political allies.
Spoiler alert: nothing trickled down.

From time to time, I like to get personal on my Substack. Thanks for following along. 

Today I want to talk about aging...

I turn 80 this year (gulp). https://robertreich.substack.com/p/my-problem-with-aging

Trump won WI by less than 1% in 2024.

Last night, progressive Chris Taylor defeated her GOP-backed opponent by 20 points in the WI Supreme Court race — flipping longtime Republican strongholds and securing a liberal court majority until 2030.

The midterm reckoning is here.
Here's the truth about California's proposed wealth tax that billionaires don't want you to know.

It’s never been more clear that Donald Trump has completely lost his mind. It’s our responsibility to call on Congress, the military, and any sane individual in this administration to stop him from committing war crimes against the Iranian people.

Billionaires are crying foul about California's proposed wealth tax. Don't fall for their fearmongering. A one-time, 5% tax on their excessive wealth is essential to funding what millions of Californians need — and to preserving our democracy.

Why does the American tax system favor the wealthy? And how did it get this way? I chatted with Jon Stewart about this back in 2012. Sadly it's only gotten worse since then. We must keep up the fight to fix the system.

Are you tired of winning yet?

53 years ago today, the last U.S. combat troops left South Vietnam, ending America’s direct role in the Vietnam War. I remember seeing this anti-war PSA back then. Its message is sadly still very relevant today as Trump drags us into another unpopular war.
